# @wordplus/realtime

> WordPlus Cloud's realtime SDK for sites and apps outside WordPress: rooms with emit, emitWithAck and volatile, presence and who is online, history, webhooks, calls between two people that ring in the browser, group calls, and the ready-made chat, online list and call screen of Better Messages, sealed end to end. The app's server (this package's ./server for Node, wordplus/realtime-php for PHP and Laravel, wordplus-realtime for Python) declares rooms and calls by pattern and decides who may join them. The browser part (this package, ./react, ./native) connects to WordPlus Cloud, joins rooms and opens what arrives.

## Docs

All of them, with the pages of the PHP and Python packages, on the web: https://docs.wordplus.cloud/llms.txt. The server's code is shown for Node, PHP and Python alike.

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): the app in WordPlus Cloud, its key, secret and local key, the server's routes (Next.js, Express, Hono, Laravel, plain PHP, Django, FastAPI, Flask), connect() in the browser, a first room
- [Why WordPlus Cloud](docs/why.md): what the cloud runs and adds beside a framework's own websockets
- [Rooms](docs/rooms.md): names and patterns, declaring rooms and their rules, what a room keeps and allows, joining, history
- [Presence and who is online](docs/presence.md): a presence room's members, counting, rt.online across the app, <online-list>
- [Sending from your server](docs/sending.md): to().emit(), toUser(), except(), batch(), in() (count, members, history, forget, kick), webhooks
- [Events from the page](docs/events.md): a room's emit list, emit, emitWithAck, volatile, timeout, <chat-room>
- [Calls, group calls and the call screen](docs/calls.md): calls() and groupCalls(), calls between two people, adding people, group calls, <call-button>, end reasons
- [Encryption and your users](docs/encryption.md): what is sealed, the local key, who gets which key, rotating, rt.users()
- [React, React Native and Capacitor](docs/react.md): RealtimeProvider, useRoom, usePresence, useOnline, useUserEvent, useCalls, Chat, OnlineList, @wordplus/realtime-ui's components in the app's own tree, the native entry
- [Customizing the screens](docs/customizing.md): the look, a piece of the app's own (components, CallControl, ::part(), <template slot>), the whole view copied (npx @wordplus/realtime-ui add, diff, update, accept, preview), what must keep working
- [Server reference](docs/server.md): createRealtime()'s options, rules, sending, routes
- [Browser reference](docs/browser.md): connect(), Realtime, Room, Online, Calls, Call, GroupCall
- [Errors](docs/errors.md): every refusal's code
- [Limits](docs/limits.md)

## For agents

- [Skill](skills/wordplus-realtime-apps/SKILL.md): which feature fits, the workflow, templates for Node, Next.js, Laravel, Django and FastAPI, customizing the screens, rules, checks
